er_inputs.core_source: Existing simulation assumption. Supplier confirmation pending.

stack_model_limits: Published material thicknesses are retained without adjustment, while 1.6 mm is the board order nominal. Soldermask thickness, dielectric loss and finished thickness tolerances are unqualified. The KiCad round-trip preserved all eleven layer entries.
actual_width_examples_note: Width tally is in nanometers. A track is classified inside U1/U2 only if both endpoints lie in the courtyard. Pad-to-track clearance is screened on native KiCad copper shapes for foreign nets. The observed 0.079189 mm is an upper bracket.

published_dfm_comparison.result: The 694 routed vias fit the dimensional baseline. The 147 U1 pad-to-track findings below 0.09 mm and the 20 narrow segments crossing or outside U1/U2 courtyards require review of the BGA process envelope.

parallel_dqs_segments.method: Same-layer near-parallel segments with at least 0.10 mm along-track overlap and centerline separation corresponding to 0–0.50 mm edge gap. Endpoint separation and pair skew are excluded.

no_routed_usb_or_mdi_pair_segments: The main 320-join board contains no copper tracks on the matched USB high-speed or MDI differential nets. Existing experimental Ethernet and USB routing copies are distinct.

nominal_diff_impedance_examples.limits: Nominal open-reference field-model values for stated geometries, not measured or manufacturer-controlled targets.
